quarterly_data.quarter: DigitalOcean press release: DigitalOcean Launches Managed Agents, Bringing Agent (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: DigitalOcean launched Managed Agents in public preview on September 22, 2026, after a private preview: each agent session gets its own hardware-isolated Harness Runtime (a lightweight microVM with built-in tools and a coding sandbox; pause, resume and fork), the Action Gateway gives governed access to more than 16,000 tools from over 500 providers through one managed MCP endpoint, and the Inference Engine connects agents to Serverless Inference across 75+ open and proprietary models (DigitalOcean-hosted open-weight models such as Nemotron 3 Ultra, Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3, proprietary models such as Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT 6 Astra). It runs Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Hermes and LangGraph agents unmodified. Company claims (DigitalOcean testing): resume from pause in 305 ms, 46% faster than other leading offerings, and up to 37% lower monthly TCO than the leading independent sandbox provider. Active CPU billing: $0.044 per vCPU-hour, memory $0.0095 per GB-hour, snapshots $0.005 per GiB-month.
quarterly_data.figure: public preview September 22, 2026; 16,000+ tools from over 500 providers; 75+ models; $0.044 per vCPU-hour

quarterly_data.signal: Managed Agents customers: OpenHands, Qencode and Amplitude are already building on DigitalOcean Managed Agents. Qencode built a support-triage agent on it; OpenHands uses it for agent execution in isolated microVMs for its Agent Canvas; Amplitude will use the Harness Runtime and Action Gateway to scale its Wave product.
